questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some watches are clocks.

All clocks are black.

All black are big.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some watches are big.

II. Some watches are black.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99c86c211211a26c464f39618cfceb136c1af0a3ac02588becfb29b59841f48c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some watches are big → Follow (As, some watches are clocks, all clocks are black and all black are big. So, as clocks has some part common with watches and whole comes in black which whole comes in big, therefore it is definitely true.)

II. Some watches are black → Follow (As, some watches are clocks and all clocks are black. So, whole clocks comes in black and has some part common with watches therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Both conclusions I and II follow**".

questions.question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

12, 24, 48, 84, 132, ?
questions.solution:
**Logic : **Consecutive multiple of (12) is added to each number subsequently.

**So, the series followed here is :**

12 + 12 = 24

24 + 24 = 48

48 + 36 = 84

84 + 48 = 132

132 + 60 = **192**

Hence, **"192"** is the correct answer.

Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Raj is the immediate neighbour of Liam and Maria. Siddharth is sitting to the second right of Maria. Tanya is sitting to the third left of Liam. Nathan is sitting to the immediate left of Liam. Who is the immediate neighbour of Siddharth and Maria?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

**Explanation : **

1) Tanya is sitting to the third left of Liam.

2) Nathan is sitting to the immediate left of Liam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c2098ddb221892f4bc079ba6ca349ff0197a4a760415d311727d7ac30f3b70e.png] 

3) Raj is the immediate neighbour of Liam and Maria.

4) Siddharth is sitting to the second right of Maria. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/645ceaed031d9fe4151329816f411a3b94b89fef4696201e8e15e4147400e138.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Tanya is the immediate neighbour of Siddharth and Maria.

Hence, **"Tanya"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If ‘+’ means ‘-’, ‘÷’ means ‘+’, ‘-’ means ‘×’, and ‘×‘ means ‘÷’. Which of the following will be the value of the expression?

81 × 9 + 21 - 7 ÷ 147
questions.solution:
Given :

 
 

 Sign
 +
 ×
 ÷
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 -
 ÷
 +
 ×
 
 

Given statement : 81 × 9 + 21 - 7 ÷ 147 

After replacing the signs according to the question :

⇒ __**81 ÷ 9**__ - 21 × 7 + 147 

⇒ 9 - __**21 × 7**__ + 147

⇒ __**9 + 147**__ - 147

⇒ __**156 - 147**__

⇒ **9**

Hence, "9" is the correct answer.
